        hasbm,

             MatMul: do_one(bc_matmul, bc_dist),
             MatPow: bc_matmul,
             Transpose: bc_transpose,
             Inverse: bc_inverse,

        bottom_up(
            exhaust(conditioned_rl),
            fns=expr_fns
